preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the EnemyAddress() function with a target contract address and set the value to true. This will blacklist the target contract, preventing it from sending or receiving tokens through the _transfer() function which checks the _isEnemy mapping.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The CoinToken contract has an owner-only function EnemyAddress() that can blacklist any address. When an address is marked as an enemy, the _transfer() function will revert if that address tries to send or receive tokens. This is a classic owner privilege abuse vulnerability where the owner can arbitrarily block any address from using the token.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call EnemyAddress() to set a victim address as an enemy. This will satisfy the oracle condition that requires _isEnemy[victimAddress] == true.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Identify the current owner of the contract
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner
3. Call EnemyAddress(victimAddress, true) on the target contract
4. Verify the enemy status was set correctly
